reason: I move money through K PLUS, BBL and TTB most weeks and I do want to stop typing everything in, but an iPhone Shortcut setup sounds like a fiddly thing I would have to babysit every month. I would rather use the banking app's own history or just type the few entries I care about.
objection: Setting up the Shortcut looks complicated, and if it breaks on an update or a new slip format I will be stuck with a half-working budget app.
would_change_my_mind: A setup that takes a few minutes with step-by-step screenshots in Thai, and a free trial I can cancel without anything being charged.
